summary: Publication engineering is verified; the requested served-model and scientific comparison objective is not complete

actionability.evidence: The actual paired main PDFs and complete supplements are available at stable project paths; machine-readable traces, review receipts and final verification record give exact commands and limits
actionability.gap: Rebuilding historical NPC evidence requires an explicit fa9fb8a source root; collecting the requested model comparison is not authorized by this closed scope

conciseness.evidence: The handoff can lead with the unmet scientific conclusion and link the two main PDFs and audit instead of repeating raw logs
conciseness.gap: The necessary forensic appendix and bounded review limitations add technical detail beyond the short user-facing result
conciseness.improvement: Keep those details in the linked audit and appendix rather than duplicating them in the final chat

critical_issues: Completeness 2/5: no identity-qualified new model comparison exists
top_improvements: Obtain verifiable provider-origin per-response identity/revision under a new prospective, authorized study before making model or ontology-effect claims
self_check: The user can accept the verified publication artifacts, but should not accept the original model-comparison objective as completed
verdict: Deliver publication artifacts with scientific objective explicitly NOT_MET; do not claim full completion or launch more models
